concerns.text: FR-006 states the system MUST validate the availability and relevance of the data collection environment and participant recruitment tools before the user study begins, but provides no concrete, observable criteria or test procedure to verify this validation.

The edge‑case handling for code snippets that exceed the model’s context window says the system MUST truncate to a predefined maximum token limit, yet the actual token limit value is not specified, making the behavior untestable.
